about: Mutants of the terminal cell host (T1 and NS6, wf10/dod/NS6). Killers are the examples suite (examples:cells: the laws of grid, host and scenes, and the CLI cases); each rule names the law or case that kills it.

mutants.name: t1-diff-skips-line-end
mutants.rule: DiffReplaysToGrid: a frame writes a changed cell at a row's end too (T1's mutant: a cell skipped at a line end).

mutants.name: t1-frame-writes-through
mutants.to: if cell == At(was, c, r) && at != c {
mutants.rule: FrameWritesTheChanges and PatchWritesItsChange (the counted guard): a frame writes only the cells that changed, not the unchanged cells after a run.

mutants.name: t1-frame-marks-per-run
mutants.rule: FrameIsOneUpdate: a frame is one synchronized update, not one per run of cells.

mutants.name: ns6-draw-rounds-down
mutants.to: let at = Rect{C: floor(b.X / CellW), R: floor(b.Y / CellH), W: cellOf(b.X+b.W, CellW) - floor(b.X/CellW), H: cellOf(b.Y+b.H, CellH) - floor(b.Y/CellH)}
mutants.rule: HitMatchesDraw (NS6 item 2's mutant): drawing rounds a box down while hit testing rounds to the nearest grid line; the cell a control is drawn in no longer hits it.

mutants.name: ns6-pressable-name-blank
mutants.from: d = named(g, x.Label, at.C+1, mid, d, pen)
mutants.to: d = named(g, strings.Slice(x.Label, 0, 0), at.C+1, mid, d, pen)
mutants.rule: CellsShowEveryName (NS6 item 1's mutant): a Pressable with only a Canvas (or nothing) inside is drawn as empty cells instead of its name.

mutants.name: ns6-flush-per-op
mutants.rule: PatchIsOneFrame (NS6 item 3's mutant): a frame after each op of a patch; the fake terminal's log holds more frames than patches.

mutants.name: ns6-check-mark-lost
mutants.rule: The marks table: a checked Check shows [x] (case counter-play).

mutants.name: ns6-tap-only-focuses
mutants.rule: CounterAgrees and TodoAgrees: a tap on a control that takes the focus also presses it, as on the test host.

mutants.name: ns4-expanded-mark-lost
mutants.from: out = out + if e.Value { m.Expanded } else { m.Collapsed }
mutants.rule: CellsShowEveryName: a Semantic node's declared Expanded state shows its mark (▾ or ▸).

mutants.name: ns4-popup-mark-lost
mutants.rule: CellsShowEveryName: a Semantic node that has a popup shows its mark.

mutants.name: ns4-semantic-press-lost
mutants.from:
declaresPress(x.On)
	case ui.BoxNode, ui.RowNode, ui.ColumnNode, ui.ScrollNode, ui.TextNode, ui.InputNode
mutants.to:
declaresPress(x.On) && false
	case ui.BoxNode, ui.RowNode, ui.ColumnNode, ui.ScrollNode, ui.TextNode, ui.InputNode
mutants.rule: HitMatchesDraw: a tap on an enabled Semantic node that declares a press sends its signal.

mutants.name: ns4-zone-targeted
mutants.to:
case ui.ScrollNode, ui.RowsNode:
		false
	case ui.ZoneNode:
		true
mutants.rule: HitMatchesDraw: the hit test names a zone's Area, not the zone, so a tap on a zone reaches the Area.

mutants.name: ns4-zone-over-none
mutants.from: topZone(h, area, func(b layout.Box) bool { holds(Span(b), c, r) })
mutants.rule: HitMatchesDraw: a tap on an Area names the zone drawn in the tapped cell (Point.Over), so the Area's zone event comes.

mutants.name: ugb22-field-by-placeholder
mutants.from: Some{Value: if x.Label != "" { x.Label } else { x.Placeholder }}
mutants.rule: A script names a labelled field by its label, as ui.Find does (law TodoAgrees; case todo-play).
